title: 落地了，就回家
logline: 深夜塔台管制员苏青，以标准专业术语引导晚点三小时、由二十年前飞行教官周远航执飞的航班落地，克制对话最终回归师生温情，传递出行核心主张。

shots.narrationZh: 深夜的风，掠过塔台环形舷窗
shots.narrationEn: The midnight wind sweeps past the tower's circular cabin windows.
shots.visual: Night airport control tower interior, circular cabin windows, distant runway light strings, cold glow of multiple radar screens, Su Qing in dark blue uniform sits at the control position with a headset on, focused on the screen.
shots.ttsDirection: 冷峻沉静，语速偏慢，气息平稳，『风』『掠过』轻读带滞涩感

shots.visual: Su Qing faces the communication panel, headset covering her ears, finger gently tapping the panel, a half-empty coffee cup placed on the side of the panel, radar glow reflected on her focused face.

lines.zh: 华夏航空三二八，塔台，可以落地，跑道二七左
lines.en: Air China 328, Tower, cleared to land runway 27 left.

shots.ttsDirection: 沉稳克制，语速平稳，气息平稳，专业术语发音清晰无起伏

shots.visual: Cockpit of the airliner, Zhou Yuanhang in white pilot uniform with four rank stripes, short black hair mixed with white, sits upright with correct posture, hands resting on the control stick, runway lights visible through the front windshield.
shots.ttsDirection: 沉稳略带倦意，语速平缓，气息略沉，操作指令发音利落

shots.narrationZh: 夜风裹着跑道温度，拂过机翼
shots.narrationEn: The midnight wind wraps around the runway temperature, brushing the aircraft wing.
shots.visual: Su Qing stares at the radar screen showing the flight's position approaching the runway, headset wire hanging on the edge of the desk, faint steam rising from the coffee cup beside her.
shots.ttsDirection: 克制中藏微澜，语速稍缓，气息轻颤，『跑道温度』重读带暖意

shots.visual: Su Qing freezes for a moment, slowly looks up at the flashing navigation lights of the flight outside the cabin window, her finger pauses slightly on the communication panel.

lines.en: Su Qing, this is Zhou Yuanhang.

shots.ttsDirection: 恍惚微震，语速放缓，气息微滞，停顿半秒后重读『跑道灯』

shots.visual: The flight lands smoothly on the runway, wheels rolling on the pavement with faint sparks, runway light strings and tower glow interweave, a minimalist travel service app logo floats in the lower right corner of the frame.
shots.ttsDirection: 释然欣慰，语速舒缓，气息放软，『回家』重读带暖意
